core_obligations: Variable and application cases (proof lines 1242-1243): each a one-word exercise marker; both reduce to unfolding FV and the induction hypothesis without any interaction with x.

Abstraction case (lines 1244-1260): definedness forces the substitution through the binder with x distinct from y and x absent from the body's relevant sets; a four-line chain of equalities returns FV of the abstraction unchanged, applying the induction hypothesis at the body.
proof_roadmap: Induct on the formation of M.
Unfold the definedness through the binder in the abstraction case.
Run the four-step equality chain closing FV unchanged.
